No live pack is named for garden-court, sundial, birdbath, planter, trellis, cold-frame or lavabo. Nearby live packs (outdoor-props, herbalist workbench, bathhouse wash-basin, well, cistern, waymarker-stone, pottery) are different families. No family was swapped.
judgment_calls: Each of the six pieces is a one-cell floor prop with a bottom-centre pivot.
This is deliberate: the sundial plate box fills the recessed hour lines.
This is deliberate: the planter trough and the cold-frame trough are filled (the soil is a solid fill); there is no opening into either trough.
The birdbath mouth, the lavabo mouth, the openings in the trellis lattice, and the opening under the raised cold-frame lid are real collider openings.
The lavabo is a free-standing pedestal basin with a small bronze spout, so it reads apart from the birdbath.
Flat slot albedos with light noise; image nodes are not in the FBX materials.

assets.name: prop-sundial-stone
assets.desc: Stone plinth and shaft under a dial plate with incised hour lines and a bronze gnomon. This is deliberate: the plate collider fills the recessed hour lines.

assets.name: prop-birdbath-stone
assets.desc: Stone pedestal with an open shallow bowl and a water disc below the rim. The mouth above the water is a real gap.

assets.name: prop-planter-stone
assets.desc: Rectangular stone trough with soil and a simple shrub. This is deliberate: the trough and soil share one filled box; there is no opening into the trough.

assets.name: prop-trellis-wood
assets.desc: Timber posts and rails with a coarse lattice and iron post caps. The openings in the lattice are real gaps.

assets.name: prop-cold-frame
assets.desc: Low timber box with soil and a sloped lid, slightly open, holding two pale glaze panes. The opening under the raised lid is a real gap. This is deliberate: the trough box is filled.

assets.name: prop-lavabo-stone
assets.desc: Free-standing stone pedestal basin with a small bronze spout and a water disc below the rim. The mouth above the water is a real gap.
